entries.german: Albrecht von Adelsheim zu Schrozberg bietet seine Vermittlung an im Streit zwischen Rothenburg und Zeisolf von Rosenberg.
entries.english: Albrecht von Adelsheim of Schrozberg offers his mediation in the dispute between Rothenburg and Zaisolph von Rosenberg.

facts.content: was involved in a dispute with Rothenburg for which Albrecht von Adelsheim offered mediation.
